component.name: Work Order
component.description: Takes the product to build and how long each stage should take.
component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: START
name: Work Order
description: Takes the product to build and how long each stage should take.
tags:
  - beginner
  - start
external_in_port:
  port_name: external_in
  port_type: external_in
  artifact_type_input: json
  artifact_type_output: none
  request_data:
    product:
      type: string
      description: What the line should make, for example "bicycle frame".
    seconds_per_stage:
      type: integer
      description: How long each of the four stages works, 1 to 30 seconds.
output_ports:
  - port_name: output
    port_type: out
    artifact_type_input: json
    artifact_type_output: none
    response_data:
      product:
        type: string
        description: What the line should make.
      seconds_per_stage:
        type: integer
        description: How long each stage works.
input_parameters: []
input_prompt: Name a product and how many seconds each stage should take.
required_secrets: []

product.description: What the line should make, for example "bicycle frame".

seconds_per_stage.description: How long each of the four stages works, 1 to 30 seconds.
